correctness.scope: Finite reference checks; separate projection diagnostic image is not the public whole O image or a performance result.

static.scope: Compiler intervals only; not additive hardware savings or measured stall attribution.

adoption.reason: Whole O is slower than both contemporary E134 controls. No live changes or performance repetition.

further_tuning.reason: No factors/row-stage/tile sweep. A bounded internal-cost diagnostic would need an explicit implementable repair question and root authorization.
further_tuning.recovery_diagnostic: Root authorized one frozen E134/E137v2 internal profile; no production edits or new performance repetitions. Test whether global amax and packed-term replication delay native readiness and next-weight issue; possible consumer-local quant repair only after measured evidence.

major_research.reason: Original-weight native E4 and fused Term/K16 reduction work in tested standard and projection cases. No internal NPU trace identifies which quantization/globalamax/replication/weight dependency limits completion. This single prototype does not exhaust native O or prove a particular added task is the physical cause.
